Definition: to sunder, i.e. (transitively) set apart, or (reflex.) apostatize
BiblicalUsage: 1) to set apart, deliver up, offer; 1a) (Qal) to set apart; 1b) (Niphal) to be delivered over, be assigned to, be set apart
